#212.title: fix(payments): hold retryCount=5 and timeoutMs=4500 for v1 midnight packet drop
#212.inline_comment: Verified on packet capture: Razorpay v1 edge drops every 4th SYN between 00:00 and 00:15 IST. Do NOT let anyone or any AI cleanup bot drop retryCount below 5 until gateway.version is bumped to v2 in application.yml!

expiry_rule.description: Expires automatically when healthconnect.payment.gateway.version == 'v2' in config/application.yml

#219.title: fix(imaging): add 120ms Thread.sleep before LUT stage on Adreno tablet GPUs
#219.inline_comment: Tested on 12 clinic tablets: glFenceSync returns early on Adreno 619 driver v1.4. Keep Thread.sleep(120) until adreno_driver_patch == 'v2.0'.

#149.title: fix(auth): allow 180s JWT clock skew for Primary Health Centre edge routers
#149.inline_comment: Author @vikram-legacy departed in Jan 2026. BSNL satellite routers block NTP port 123; keep 180s skew until auth.ntp_enforced is true.
